title: Font payload is 42% of landing/game weight: 4 fonts, 92 KB, only 2 preloaded; sans variable font (46 KB) causes late swap

steps: Load / and /game/<id> on Slow 3G, list requests
expected: Lean fonts (subset, fewer weights) and every above-the-fold font preloaded
